anxious.en: Someone who is socially anxious is nervous or worried about speaking to other people.
anxious.zh: 有社交焦虑的人在与他人交谈时会感到紧张或担忧。

anxious.en: And finally, if you're frazzled, you feel tired or anxious because you're doing too much.
anxious.zh: 最后，如果你感到精疲力竭（frazzled），你就会因为做了太多事情而感到疲倦或焦虑。

anxious.en: Avoidance behavior is when people stay away from situations that make them uncomfortable or anxious.
anxious.zh: 回避行为是指人们远离那些让他们感到不舒服或焦虑的情境。

anxious.en: The prisoners, who were healthy and confident at the start, became passive, anxious, and even traumatised.
anxious.zh: 而那些一开始健康又自信的囚犯，则变得被动、焦虑，甚至留下了心理创伤。

anxious.en: You don’t need to be embarrassed or feel anxious or feel uncomfortable.
anxious.zh: 你不需要出丑、感到焦虑或浑身不自在。

anxiety.en: Well done. The amygdala is associated with our processing of fear and anxiety.
anxiety.zh: 干得好。杏仁核与我们对恐惧和焦虑的处理有关。

anxiety.en: Nerves is an informal word for worry or anxiety, but according to Claudia, nerves aren't necessarily bad.
anxiety.zh: “紧张”是担忧或焦虑的非正式说法，但根据克劳迪娅的说法，紧张不一定坏事。

anxiety.en: Hypervigilance, the noun, is a state of extreme alertness and sensitivity to surroundings, possibly of extreme anxiety.
anxiety.zh: 名词 hypervigilance（过度警觉）是一种对周围环境极度警惕和敏感的状态，可能伴随极度焦虑。

anxiety.en: Nerves are an informal word for worry or anxiety.
anxiety.zh: Nerves 是担忧或焦虑的非正式说法。

anxiety.en: If you can reduce your stress, reduce your anxiety, have a good night’s sleep so you feel less tired, you’ll become more confident.
anxiety.zh: 如果你能减轻压力、减少焦虑、美美地睡上一觉从而感觉不那么疲惫，你就会变得更自信。

ankle.en: Around their ankles, they had chains that rattled as they walked, a constant reminder of their lack of freedom.
ankle.zh: 脚踝上戴着锁链，走路时会哗啦作响，时刻提醒着他们失去了自由。

ankle.en: They found that his brain was a lot less active than the brains of his peers when he rotated his right ankle.
ankle.zh: 他们发现，当Neymar旋转右脚踝时，他的大脑活跃度比同龄人要低得多。

anonymous.en: We've got an anonymous one here, who recently received a single emoji in response to a carefully considered and worded email.
anonymous.zh: 我们这里有一个匿名听众，他最近在发送了一封经过仔细思考和斟酌的邮件后，只收到一个表情符号作为回复。

anonymous.en: For 17 years he had been sending anonymous bombs, and this was the first time not just the public, but also the authorities, would understand why.
anonymous.zh: 17年来，他一直神出鬼没地邮寄炸弹，而这是公众乃至当局第一次明白他为什么要这么做。

anonymous.en: The anonymous author—who signed his letters as “FC”, short for Freedom Club—he believed that modern technological society was not simply flawed, but fundamentally incompatible with human freedom.
anonymous.zh: 这位匿名作者——他在信中署名“FC”，即自由俱乐部（Freedom Club）的缩写——他认为现代技术社会不仅有瑕疵，而且与人类的自由根本水火不容。

anonymous.en: It was anonymous, you never knew who the sellers were, and even if a buyer's home address was identified, they could simply say they didn’t know anything about the package, and it must have been a mistake.
anonymous.zh: 它是匿名的，你永远不知道卖家是谁，而且即使买家的家庭地址被确认了，他们也可以简单地声称自己对这个包裹一无所知，这一定是个错误。

anonymous.en: It was perfect. Every transaction was public, so nobody could say, “I didn’t get it”, and it was also practically anonymous, meaning nobody–not the seller, not the buyer, not the authorities–nobody would be able to see the true identity of the individuals involved in the transaction.
anonymous.zh: 这太完美了。每笔交易都是公开的，所以没人能说“我没收到”；同时它实际上又是匿名的，这意味着没有人——无论是卖家、买家还是监管机构——能够看到参与交易的个人的真实身份。

ancestor.en: Polynesians were a group of seafaring people whose ancestors originally came from Southeast Asia.
ancestor.zh: 波利尼西亚人是一群航海民族，他们的祖先最初来自东南亚。

ancestor.en: This is because the Moai were believed to represent ancestors or powerful leaders.
ancestor.zh: 这是因为人们相信 Moai 代表着祖先或强有力的领袖。

ancestor.en: Human beings evolved in environments that were unpredictable, so our ancestors faced uncertainty all the time.
ancestor.zh: 人类进化于不可预测的环境中，因此我们的祖先时刻面对着不确定性。

ancestor.en: What we do know is that for a very long period, our ancestors were not making fire.
ancestor.zh: 我们所知道的是，在很长的一段时间里，我们的祖先并不是自己生火。

ancestor.en: Like 'ancestors', the term forebears means actual people - the relatives in your family from a long time ago.
ancestor.zh: 就像“祖先”（ancestors）一样，forebears这个词指的是真正的人——你家族中很久以前的亲戚。

ancient.en: Some ancient artefacts being sold online and in stores have been looted and trafficked.
ancient.zh: 一些在网上和商店里出售的古代文物是被掠夺和走私得来的。

ancient.en: Even if their culture is ancient, the official country might still be relatively new.
ancient.zh: 即使它们的文化是古老的，官方的国家可能依然相对较新。

ancient.en: The list changed slightly over time, but several monuments regularly appeared in ancient Greek writings.
ancient.zh: 这份名单随着时间推移略有变化，但有几个古迹经常出现在古希腊的著作中。

ancient.en: The name comes from Ancient Greek and literally means “the land between rivers “.
ancient.zh: 这个名字源自古希腊语，字面意思是“两河之间的土地”。

ancient.en: Most historians believe the first culture to develop writing was the ancient Mesopotamians.
ancient.zh: 大多数历史学家认为，第一个发展出文字的文化是古代美索不达米亚人。

analyst.en: OK. We'll find out the answer later. Let's travel first to Singapore, home of Jolene Ng, a market research analyst who specialises in salty snacks.
analyst.zh: 好的。我们稍后会揭晓答案。让我们先去新加坡，那里是专门研究咸味零食的市场研究分析师 Jolene Ng 的家乡。

anniversary.en: Yet in just over 60 years’ time, one institution will celebrate its 1,000 year anniversary.
anniversary.zh: 然而在仅仅 60 多年之后，一个机构将庆祝它的千禧年诞辰。

anniversary.en: This year, the US is celebrating the 250 th anniversary since it declared independence from the British Empire.
anniversary.zh: 今年，美国正在庆祝其宣布脱离大英帝国独立二百五十周年。

anniversary.en: Last year marked the 40th anniversary of the International Whaling Commission's global moratorium – that's a temporary ban on the commercial killing of whales.
anniversary.zh: 去年是国际捕鲸委员会全球暂禁令(moratorium)实施 40 周年——这是一项对商业捕鲸的临时禁令。

analyse.en: Most major dictionaries now analyse enormous databases of written and spoken English.
analyse.zh: 如今，大多数主流词典都会分析规模庞大的英语书面和口语数据库。

analyse.en: These analyse the smells for danger. The reason you can't smell your own home is that it isn’t a threat to you.
analyse.zh: 这些器官会分析气味以寻找危险。你闻不到自己家的原因是因为它对你没有威胁。

analyse.en: She analysed hundreds of their conversations.
analyse.zh: 她分析了他们数百段对话。

analyse.en: By analysing billions of words on social media, or even the emotional tone of song lyrics, they attempt to track collective happiness in real time.
analyse.zh: 通过分析社交媒体上的数十亿个单词，甚至是歌曲歌词的情感基调，他们试图实时追踪集体幸福感。

analyse.en: The theory gained significant support in the early 2000s, when scientists analysed samples of George's hair and found arsenic at levels roughly a hundred times higher than those in healthy people.
analyse.zh: 这一理论在 2000 年代初得到了重大支持，当时科学家分析了 George 的头发样本，发现其中的砷含量大约是健康人的百倍左右。

announce.en: So at the beginning of May, the UAE announced it was leaving OPEC.
announce.zh: 所以在5月初，阿联酋宣布退出OPEC。

announce.en: The final results were announced on July 7th, 2007, written numerically as 07/07/07, for the Seven Wonders.
announce.zh: 最终结果于2007年7月7日公布，数字写出来就是07/07/07，对应七大奇迹。

announce.en: It formally announced that the colonies were no longer British colonies.
announce.zh: 它正式宣告这些殖民地不再是英国的殖民地。

announce.en: The government's response, which was announced earlier this year by the Justice Secretary David Lammy, is radical.
announce.zh: 政府给出的应对方案十分激进，这项方案是今年早些时候由司法大臣戴维·拉米(David Lammy)宣布的。

announce.en: Its meetings are public. Its policies are officially announced.
announce.zh: 它的会议是公开的。它的政策是官方宣布的。

analysis.en: One analysis estimated that these cuts could lead to a $10 billion loss in economic activity and 44,000 jobs across the country.
analysis.zh: 一项分析估计，这些削减可能导致全美经济活动损失 100 亿美元，并减少 44,000 个工作岗位。

anticipate.en: Downloads and plays on Spotify are lower than I anticipated or expected this year.
anticipate.zh: 今年 Spotify 上的下载量和播放量低于我的预期。

anticipate.en: Strategically, this mission made a lot of sense, and the British and French forces, two of the strongest military forces in the world, anticipated moving through the peninsula with minimal resistance.
anticipate.zh: 从战略上讲，这项任务非常合乎逻辑，作为世界上最强大的两支军事力量，英法军队预计能够以最小的抵抗穿过半岛。

anchor.en: Maybe it would be by using large nets or tethers to anchor it, or by synchronising mining tools to match the asteroid’s rotation.
anchor.zh: 也许可以通过使用大网或系绳来锚定它，或者通过同步采矿工具来配合小行星的旋转来实现。

antarctic.en: French Guiana, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Réunion, Mayotte, French Polynesia, New Caledonia, Saint Barthélemy, Saint Martin, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, the French Southern and Antarctic Lands, and Clipperton Island.
antarctic.zh: 法属圭亚那、瓜德罗普、马提尼克、留尼汪、马约特、法属波利尼西亚、新喀里多尼亚、圣巴泰勒米、圣马丁、圣皮埃尔和密克隆、法属南部和南极领地，以及克利珀特恩岛。

antarctic.en: We can describe all of these as territories in a general sense because they’re land, but in a legal sense, France has one overseas territory, which is the French Southern and Antarctic Lands.
antarctic.zh: 我们可以从广义上将所有这些描述为领地，因为它们是土地，但在法律意义上，法国有一个海外领地，那就是法属南部和南极领地。
